description: This file defines the RemoveRelated class, which is a method operation in the Minilang framework for removing related entities from a given entity in OFBiz. It processes the <remove-related> XML element, utilizes entity delegation to remove relationships, and integrates with the overall MiniLang execution context.

classes.name: RemoveRelated
classes.description: Implements a method operation to remove related entity records based on a specified relation name and entity value.

classes.name: RemoveRelatedFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of RemoveRelated from XML elements.

methods.name: RemoveRelated
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation with XML element attributes such as relation name and value field.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the removal of related entities by calling getDelegator().removeRelated() on the entity value.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Adds the relation name to the artifact info context for tracking dependencies.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of this operation.
